title: 第10章 脱胎换骨
content_zh:
第10章脱胎换骨
王佛宝来去匆匆，杨狱却是久久无法平复心境。
杨婆婆擦着手走进屋子里，有些嗔怪道：“你这孩子，怎么不留住王捕头？”
“哪里留得住？”
杨狱笑的勉强。
一日里几次大起大落，他只觉身体有些发虚，趁着婆婆不注意，连吃了好几粒石子才好了一些。
“老头子生死未卜，也不知能不能回来，你一个小娃娃没了依靠，在衙门可怎么呆得下去……”
老妇人絮絮叨叨，满脸担忧。
“婆婆。”
杨狱心中一暖，握住老妇人的手，道：“王捕头送来了抚恤……”
“抚恤……”
老妇人呆了呆，握着钱袋的手有些颤抖。
见婆婆又难过起来，杨狱忙开口转移话题：“婆婆，王捕头说外城不太平，要我们搬去内城……”
“搬家？”
老妇人有些茫然的点头：“是要搬家了，巷尾那家兄弟两个一起染了重病，怕是过不去夏天了……”
杨狱默然。
今年过了才一半，外城染病而死的人都要比以前几年都要多的多了。
回想起那日胡万的话，他心中也有些紧迫。
“这年景，是越发的难过了。”
老妇人黯然叹息。

“那，雨停了我去找个牙行租个房子？”
杨狱小心翼翼，生怕让婆婆伤心。
老妇人年纪大了，身体也不是很好，再受刺激，只怕会有病。
“听你的。”
老妇人兴致不高。
这雨一下就是一早上，临近中午天才放晴，杨狱草草的扒拉了几口饭，揣起银子来到老院子里。
“随手一甩，就插的如此之深？这王捕头只怕也是换了血的高手……”
杨狱累得一头大汗，才挖开了坚硬的黄泥土，看到了刀柄在下的断刀。
心中有些咂舌。
又好一阵忙活，将断刀挖了出来，洗了洗，这才出门向内城走去。
牙行所在，正是内城乃至于黑山城最为繁华的‘南大街’。
这条街颇为繁华，诸如酒楼、茶馆、医馆之类的设施一应俱全，道旁的小摊贩更是一个接一个。
人潮涌动，是外城绝看不到的景象。
“真好似两个世界啊……”
看着穿着光鲜的行人，杨狱重重的吐出一口气，在街上游荡起来。
连日来的努力，他距离彻底炼化断刀也已经不远，来这，就是想要碰碰运气，看能不能找到其他‘食材’。
多日里的摸索，他已然知道，暴食之鼎所‘炼化’的只是物体之上留下的精神。
这么大的黑山城，类似的东西不应该没有吧？
可惜，杨狱逛了两个来回，也还是没有找到哪怕一件可能存在精神的‘食材’。
无他，南大街压根没有古物……

“来错地方了，我该去北大街……”
杨狱无奈的摇摇头，不经意的一回头，却不由的惊出一身冷汗。
一个穿着白衣的瘦高个，正在街尾冷冷的注视他，见他回头，又隐入了人群之中。
“他，他是在跟踪我？白衣，这人是怜生教的人？”
杨狱心中一紧，又有些疑惑。
他可从没招惹过怜生教的人，他们怎么会跟踪自己？
图财的话，自己身无余财，老爷子的抚恤对于其他人算是不小的数目，可怜生教哪里瞧得上？
古怪，古怪……
杨狱心中转着念头，脚步一拐，离了牙行，也没去北大街，不缓不慢的走着，却是径直来到了魏老头的小巷。
敲响了门。
“吱吱吱~”
老猴旺财叫嚷着开了门。
杨狱进了院子，今天分外冷清，练武场上连一个人都没有，只有魏老头躺在摇椅上，半睡半醒。
“你可知，老夫为何要你去杀人？”
还没踏入练武场，魏老头的声音就飘飘荡荡的传了过来。
“不知。”
杨狱摇头。
“看来，你还没有发现。”
魏老头半眯着眼，摇晃躺椅：“任何一门武功被创造出来，都是开创者为了克敌制胜，甚至是为了杀人！”
杨狱走进两步，捡了个小马扎坐下，知道自己算是真正过关了。

“任何一门武功，都蕴含着开创者的精神、气质，后人学习，无形之中就会改变性格。”
魏老头声音不急不缓，娓娓道来：
“一年前的你，唯唯诺诺，便是道旁的野狗，你也是绝不敢靠近一步，而一年后的现在，你却敢夜杀人。”
“这其中的改变，难道只是因为你喝了几口马尿不成？”
“改变性格……”
杨狱心头一震，有些恍然。
前世他就听说过，本来内向胆小的孩子学了健身、散打、拳击之类的手段，就会变得胆大。
此时琢磨琢磨，不外乎是‘身怀利刃、杀心自起’。
“老夫这辈子杀人不少，会的这点手段自然不会怎么良善，你算是个苗子，老夫不想毁了你，故而试探一二罢了。”
魏河伸了个懒腰，漫不经心。
杨狱沉默一瞬，才道：“可若是我被人反杀，或是被捕快拿了下大狱呢？”
“呵呵~”
魏河直起身子，目视杨狱，淡淡道：“自然与老夫无关。”
杨狱苦笑。
心中却是越发笃定，这魏老头绝不是个善茬。
“有什么想问的，就问吧。”
魏河打了个哈欠。
杨狱定了定心，问出心中最想知道的事情：“弟子想知道如何能够‘换血’。”
“既然过了这关，你也算是老夫的弟子了。也罢，就为你多讲上两句……”
魏老头略微沉吟，一招手唤了声‘旺财’。

那老猴在树上发出‘吱吱’叫声，一溜烟窜进了屋子里。
“学武不外乎练招式，打熬身体，增长气力，可这到底有着极限，就算是胡万那样勉强算天赋异禀的，力气也不过一头水牛。”
魏河接过老猴爪子里的黄纸，随手一抖：
“换血却不同，那是真正的脱胎换骨！过了这关，你才算个武者，内外城也大可厮混了。”
“脱胎换骨。”
杨狱听得眼神发亮，猜测道：“这血该怎么换？难不成，是药浴？！”
“不错。”
魏河略有些惊讶，点点头：“寻常的手段根本无法触及骨髓，要换血，自然要药材辅助了。”
说罢，他甩了甩手中的黄纸：
“这是‘换血’的方子，老夫倒是可以给你一份，可你，又哪来的钱财去买药材？”
“吃土，可是换不成血的！”
content_en:
Chapter 10 Reborn
Wang Fobao came and went in a hurry, but Yang Yu couldn't calm down for a long time.
Granny Yang walked into the house wiping her hands and said angrily: "You kid, why don't you keep Wang Captou?"
"Where can I keep it?"
Yang Yu smiled reluctantly.
After several ups and downs in a day, he only felt a little weak. When his mother-in-law wasn't paying attention, he ate several stones to get better.
"The old man's life or death is uncertain, and he doesn't know if he can come back. How can you, a little baby, stay in the Yamen without support..."
The old woman was chattering, her face full of worry.
"Mother-in-law."
Yang Yu felt warm in his heart, held the old woman's hand, and said: "Wang Captou sent a pension..."
"Pensions..."
The old woman was stunned, her hand holding the money bag trembling.
Seeing that his mother-in-law was feeling sad again, Yang Yu hurriedly changed the subject: "Mother-in-law, Mr. Wang said that the outer city is not peaceful and wants us to move to the inner city..."
"Moving?"
The old woman nodded blankly: "We are moving. The two brothers at the end of the alley are seriously ill together. I'm afraid they won't be able to survive the summer..."
Yang Yu was silent.
Only halfway through this year, there are far more people dying from the disease in outer cities than in previous years.
Recalling Hu Wan's words that day, he felt a little anxious.
"This year, it's getting more and more sad."
The old woman sighed sadly.
"Then, when the rain stops, I'll find a place to rent a house in Yaxing?"
Yang Prison was cautious, fearing to make his mother-in-law sad.
The old woman is old and not in good health. If she is stimulated again, she may get sick.
"It's up to you."
The old woman was not in high spirits.
It rained all morning, and it cleared up near noon. Yang Yu hurriedly took a few mouthfuls of rice, picked up the money and went to the old yard.
"With a flick of your hand, it penetrated so deeply? I'm afraid this Wang Captou is also a master who has changed his blood..."
Yang Yu was so exhausted that he was sweating profusely before digging through the hard yellow soil and saw the broken knife with the handle underneath.
I felt a little stunned in my heart.
After working hard for a while, I dug out the broken knife, washed it, and then went out to the inner city.
The location of Yaxing is the most prosperous "South Street" in the inner city and even Black Mountain City.
This street is quite prosperous, with all kinds of facilities such as restaurants, teahouses, and medical clinics, and there are also small vendors one after another along the road.
The huge crowds were a sight you would never see in the outer city.
"It's like two worlds..."
Looking at the well-dressed pedestrians, Yang Yu let out a heavy breath and started wandering on the street.
After days of hard work, he was not far away from completely refining the Broken Knife. He came here just to try his luck and see if he could find other 'ingredients'.
After many days of exploration, he already knew that what the Cauldron of Gluttony 'refined' was only the spirit left on the object.
There shouldn't be anything like this in such a big Black Mountain City, right?
Unfortunately, Yang Yu went back and forth two times and still couldn't find even one 'ingredient' that might contain spirits.
Without him, there would be no antiquities at all on South Street...
"I came to the wrong place, I should go to North Street..."
Yang Yu shook his head helplessly and turned around inadvertently, but couldn't help but break into a cold sweat.
A tall and thin man in white clothes was watching him coldly from the end of the street. When he turned around, he disappeared into the crowd again.
"He, he is following me? Baiyi, is this person from Liansheng Cult?"
Yang Yu's heart tightened and he was a little confused.
He has never provoked anyone from the Liansheng Cult, so why would they follow him?
If you want to make money, you have no money left, and the old man's pension is not a small amount for others. How can the poor student see it?
Weird, weird...
With thoughts spinning in his mind, Yang Yuan turned around and left Yaxing. He didn't go to North Street. He walked slowly and unhurriedly, but he went straight to Old Wei's alley.
There was a knock on the door.
"Zhizhizhi~"
The old monkey Wangcai shouted and opened the door.Yang Yu entered the courtyard. It was extremely deserted today. There was no one in the martial arts training ground. Only old man Wei was lying on the rocking chair, half asleep and half awake.
"Do you know why I want you to kill someone?"
Before entering the martial arts training ground, Old Man Wei's voice came floating over.
"I don't know."
Yang Prison shook his head.
"It seems that you haven't discovered it yet."
Old Man Wei squinted his eyes and shook the couch: "Any martial art is created because the founder is trying to defeat the enemy, or even kill people!"
Yang Prison took two steps forward, picked up a small horse and sat down, knowing that he had truly passed the test.
"Any martial arts contains the spirit and temperament of the founder. When later generations learn from it, their character will change invisibly."
Old Man Wei's voice was neither urgent nor slow, and he said:
"A year ago, you were just a wild dog on the roadside. You would never dare to take a step closer. But now, a year later, you dare to kill people at night."
"Is this change just because you drank a few mouthfuls of horse urine?"
"Changing personality..."
Yang Prison was shocked and suddenly realized.
In his previous life, he had heard that introverted and timid children would become bold after learning methods such as fitness, Sanda, and boxing.
Thinking about it at this time, it is nothing more than ‘having a sharp blade and having a murderous intention’.
"I've killed a lot of people in my life, and the skills I know are naturally not very good. You are a young person, and I don't want to ruin you, so I'm just testing it out."
Wei He stretched himself nonchalantly.
Yang Yu was silent for a moment and then said: "But what if I am killed by someone, or I am arrested and taken to prison immediately?"
"Haha~"
Wei He straightened up, looked at Yang Yu, and said calmly: "Of course it has nothing to do with me."
Yang Yu smiled bitterly.
But he became more and more certain in his heart that this old man Wei was definitely not a good person.
"If you have anything to ask, just ask."
Wei He yawned.
Yang Yu calmed down and asked what he wanted to know most: "This disciple wants to know how to 'exchange blood'."
"Now that you have passed this level, you can be considered my disciple. Anyway, I will tell you a few more words..."
Old Man Wei pondered for a moment, then waved his hand and called out "Wang Cai".
The old monkey made a "squeaking" sound in the tree and scurried into the house.
"Learning martial arts is nothing more than practicing moves, exercising your body, and increasing your strength. But there is a limit to this. Even someone as talented as Hu Wan is barely as strong as a buffalo."
Wei He took the yellow paper from the old monkey's paw and shook it casually:
"Exchanging blood is different. It's a true rebirth! After passing this level, you can be considered a warrior, and you can hang out in the inner and outer cities."
"Reborn."
Yang Yu's eyes lit up when he heard this, and he guessed: "How should I change this blood? Could it be a medicinal bath?!"
"Not bad."
Wei He was slightly surprised and nodded: "Ordinary methods cannot reach the bone marrow at all. If blood transfusion is needed, medicinal materials are naturally needed."
After that, he shook off the yellow paper in his hand:
"This is a prescription for 'blood transfusion'. I can give you a copy, but where will you get the money to buy the medicinal materials?"
"Eating dirt can't be exchanged for blood!"
